description: What the build does not match yet. `declarations`: the differences between the declarations the build emits and the fixed files of api/, by the number of the change that explains them; a key is <entry>:<kind>:<declaration>, the kind being removed (the build has it, the fixed file does not), added (the fixed file has it, the build does not), sig (the type differs), doc (only the TSDoc differs) or export, and its value is the digest of what the build has there now (scripts/gates/api.mjs prints it), so that a waiting declaration keeps the form it has until its change gives it the fixed form. `samples`: the samples of api/samples/ that do not type-check against the build yet, with the number of their type errors, which may not grow. `entries`: the entries of package.json that are not there yet. The list only gets shorter: the work that makes the build match removes its rows.
